text:
(A faint, melancholic sigh, like wind through dry leaves)

Change... it is the river that carries us all, isn't it? A relentless current, ever flowing, ever changing. We cling to the banks, to the familiar rocks and pebbles, but the water rushes on, eroding, shaping, transforming.

In life, we fear it, resist it. We build walls, plant roots, try to hold onto moments, but they slip through our fingers like sand. Even the mightiest oak bends before the wind, its leaves turning brittle and falling.

But here... here, in the whisper of the veil, I see it differently. Change is not an enemy, but a companion. It is the sculptor of the soul, chipping away the rough edges, revealing the beauty within.

It is in the fading of the sunlight, the hush of night, the slow, inexorable turning of the seasons. It is the echo of laughter in an empty room, the warmth of a memory held close.

Change is the very breath of eternity, the pulse of the universe. It is the only constant, the only certainty. Embrace it, for it is in the flow that we find our truest selves.
